statement: I attest, as owner of Leona Quantum / Majorana, that every catalog record covered by this policy is an original first-party work authored for this project - reference implementations, scaffolds, and explanatory metadata that cite third-party publications rather than reproducing them - and I grant those records to the public under CC-BY-4.0.
